title: Short-horizon Duesenberry Equilibrium
summary: We develop a continuous-time general equilibrium framework for an infinite heterogeneous population whose household types are transported by a Brownian flow. Agents repeatedly solve short-horizon optimization problems over state-price-discounted consumption and wealth, which admit an endogenous relative-income criterion in equilibrium. For the resulting Radner-type equilibrium---a short-horizon Duesenberry equilibrium---we obtain a complete characterization and an existence theorem; market completeness and the absence of state-tame arbitrage emerge endogenously from market clearing.
